title: Santorini Serenity
description: Escape to the iconic white-washed cliffs of Santorini, where time stands still and the Aegean Sea stretches endlessly before you.

itinerary.activity: Private sunset yacht cruise around the caldera with champagne and Mediterranean cuisine
Morning spa ritual at your villa followed by a private wine tasting at Santo Wines
Explore ancient Akrotiri ruins with a private archaeologist guide

title: Kyoto Awakening
description: Journey through ancient temples and zen gardens, discovering the soul of Japan in its former imperial capital.

itinerary.activity: Dawn meditation session at Kinkaku-ji followed by traditional kaiseki breakfast
Private tea ceremony with a master in the historic Gion district
Forest bathing in the bamboo groves of Arashiyama

title: Alpine Expedition
description: Conquer majestic peaks and embrace the raw beauty of the Swiss Alps from a luxury mountain retreat.

itinerary.activity: Helicopter transfer to your private chalet with panoramic mountain views
Guided summit climb with expert mountaineers, ending with fondue at 3,000m
Paragliding over glacial valleys followed by thermal spa immersion

title: Marrakech Mystique
description: Lose yourself in the labyrinthine souks and find peace in the tranquil riads of this ancient city.

itinerary.activity: Private riad check-in with traditional hammam and massage ritual
Sunrise hot air balloon over the Atlas Mountains with Berber breakfast
Guided meditation in the Majorelle Garden followed by sunset camel trek

title: Serengeti Safari
description: Witness the greatest wildlife spectacle on Earth from the comfort of a luxury tented camp.

itinerary.activity: Bush plane arrival and afternoon game drive spotting the Big Five
Dawn balloon safari over the migration followed by champagne bush breakfast
Walking safari with Maasai guides and sundowners overlooking the savanna

title: Nordic Solace
description: Experience the dramatic beauty of Norwegian fjords under the dancing northern lights.

itinerary.activity: Private fjord cruise to your waterfront cabin with aurora viewing deck
Guided glacier hike followed by traditional Norwegian sauna and cold plunge
Midnight sun kayaking through ancient Viking waterways
